title: account.analytic.plan — multi-plan hierarchy deep
gap_prior: NOT_PROVEN — analytic plan hierarchy never studied at L3 in prior passes
key_findings: account.analytic.plan uses Odoo _parent_store with parent_path column for efficient subtree queries
root_id is computed by splitting parent_path on '/' and taking the first segment as integer
Project plan uses fixed column name 'account_id'; all other root plans use dynamically created 'x_plan{id}_id' columns
Sub-plans create non-stored related fields for grouping by hierarchy depth rather than stored columns
analytic_distribution is a JSON field: keys are comma-separated account ID strings, values are percentages
_validate_distribution only fires when context flag 'validate_analytic' is True; sums per root plan and compares to 100 using Percentage Analytic decimal precision
Sale module calls _validate_analytic_distribution on order lines at both send-quotation and confirm-order stages
Purchase module calls _validate_analytic_distribution at button_confirm stage
stock_account adds rounding-correction algorithm (_calculate_distribution_amount) to prevent cumulative float drift across multiple analytic lines
mrp_account makes work centre model inherit analytic.mixin so labour cost distribution is available on work centres
default_applicability is company_dependent allowing per-company plan applicability configuration
Business domain applicability extensions: sale_order (sale), purchase_order (purchase), timesheet (hr_timesheet)
awt_items: Confirm validate_analytic context flag is set on account.move.line write/post in account module (runtime needed)
Confirm mrp_workorder analytic line creation path through _perform_analytic_distribution (runtime needed)

cross_module_coverage.sale: business domain + validate_analytic_distribution at quotation send and order confirm
cross_module_coverage.hr_timesheet: business domain only; validation path not confirmed at L3
cross_module_coverage.mrp_account: analytic.mixin on mrp.workcenter; distribution used in work order cost booking
